subject_entity.notes: Syriac church father in the Persian Empire; wrote 23 Demonstrations (337–345) on Christian faith and practice; possibly a bishop; used the Diatessaron as his gospel text; his theology is notably independent of Greek influence.

object_entity.notes: Twin cities on the Tigris; capital of the Parthian and Sasanian empires; seat of the Catholicos of the Church of the East from the early 4th century onward.

evidence.notes: Aphrahat's Demonstrations were composed at the Persian church center of Seleucia-Ctesiphon.
